verdict.rationale: Ramp documents rules-based approval workflows that route requests to stakeholders by vendor type, spend category, or dollar amount, and workflows targeted by spend amount or team role. Spend controls are described as including approval workflows across cards, reimbursements, bills, and agent purchases. However, nothing shows explicit sequential multi-step chains such as manager then budget owner then finance. Delegation of approval authority is never mentioned. Time-based escalation when approvers sit on requests is also absent; the AI 'escalates when it's not safe' claim is a different behavior. missing for 10: explicit multi-step sequential approver chains (manager/budget owner/finance), approver delegation/out-of-office reassignment, SLA-based escalation of stalled approvals, independent or hands-on corroboration.
